system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: MODIS Gap-Filled Long-term Land Surface Temperature Daily Daytime

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global gap-filled daily land surface temperature from MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites. This seamless high spatiotemporal dataset covers all terrestrial land areas using a novel spatiotemporal gap-filling framework.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily LST measurements from 2003 to 2020 in the Earth Engine asset.

band_semantics.LST_Day: Gap-filled daytime land surface temperature derived from MODIS Terra and Aqua observations

data_description.important_note: This dataset uses a spatiotemporal gap-filling framework combining four daily MODIS LST observations (Terra day/night, Aqua day/night) to generate seamless coverage. The method filters long-term trends and interpolates residuals to fill gaps from clouds and missing data.
analytical_capabilities: Drought monitoring through land surface conditions

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Land surface temperature in Kelvin or Celsius. The LST_Day band represents daytime surface temperature conditions.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: This gap-filled product provides continuous coverage without missing values, suitable for time series analysis and long-term trend studies.

data_description.data_source: MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites, processed by Zhang et al. via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
